release_notes: Stop fresh installs from broadcasting 'Room 1' and colliding with the office's existing Room 1 station. New computers now start with the Station name dropdown showing 'Please choose the name of this Station' instead of being preset to Room 1; the LAN beacon, peer discovery, and Ready button stay off until the user picks a real name. A red warning under the dropdown reads 'you need to choose a station to send ready alerts' until they do. Picking a name from the dropdown commits it to config and starts the network in one step -- no extra clicks. 1.0.57 fixed the *symptom* of duplicate labels (the connect/kick/reconnect storm); 1.0.58 removes the root cause so the collision never happens in the first place. Existing installs whose config already holds a real label (Room 3, Doctor, Lab, etc.) are unaffected -- only fresh installs see the prompt.
